secondary_text_reference.scope: text-only; not used for image projection or processing

modifications: Preserved the MLX-VLM implementation as a pinned optional runtime dependency rather than copying its vision and processor trees
Added strict CPU-only target and draft artifact header/config gates
Added ordinary image request preparation with image-placeholder boundary and media fingerprint

Replaced pinned mlx-vlm's non-checkpointable convolution ArraysCache allocation with mlx2's compatible checkpoint-aware ArraysCache, alongside mlx2 KVCache; APCv2 can clone and replay at exact hybrid boundaries
Added a static fp32 upper bound for retained KV, convolution state, and APCv2 convolution snapshots; forward workspace remains provisional
Kept DSpark as an auxiliary, unqualified draft that no route selects
Provided a separate offline-only lazy draft loader with strict weight load and target bind
Added explicit offline DSpark candidate generation with target verification, never selected by serving

Added opt-in, unqualified one-token Metal ShortConv candidate for pinned three-tap 2048-channel BF16 layout; the source ShortConv method remains the fallback and the candidate has no default serving selection
Resolve the pinned source checkout from the installed mlx_vlm package for portable revision verification and use the tokenizer-owned checkpoint chat template when the processor has none
Refuse a second model-local fused ShortConv installation so fallback cannot reenter a previously wrapped operator and mutate convolution state twice
Route bounded one-fps sampled video frames through the pinned multi-image processor, preserving frame order and timestamps in text labels; LFM has no separate video tower or video token

Added default-off candidate_v1 post-media APCv2 checkpoint declaration bound to adapter-prepared tokens, media fingerprint, and boundary; generic serving budgets and persists the exact interior state without model-name scheduling
Added CPU-only DSpark target compatibility preflight before draft-weight loading; reject a pinned target lacking the required rollback method

Added a SHA-pinned image/video qualification companion for the source ShortConv path, all 22 convolution states, eight attention offsets, and ordinary B1 APCv2 branches with the post-media checkpoint policy

Added an offline-only instance bridge for the pinned VL language model: exact target hidden capture, exact speculative verification, and source rollback over 22 ShortConv plus eight KV planes, with pinned-cache class guards. Serving remains ordinary-only and DSpark unselected.
